template: An Act relative to preventing algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market (H.5222) is a pending bill, not law; if enacted as written it would reach this address. Source: Bill H.5222 (194th General Court), new draft of H1564; as of 2026-01-02. Not legal advice.
